schema_note: Field order is NORMATIVE. This list is part of the frozen set flexcore-research-benchmark-set-v1 and changes only with a NEW set version.
ledger_subtask: P8.19 (step 3: the not-tested list — important cases that were NOT run, with the reason)
prohibition: Do not claim that the first distribution feeder tests establish capability for a 10,000-bus utility network (report §19.3, closing sentence; P8.02 X-7). Every item below is a case the phase must NOT be read as having covered.

items.case: a 10,000-bus utility-scale network (any transmission-scale network study)
items.status: NOT RUN — and a scale claim from the tested range is PROHIBITED
items.reason: no transmission-scale model, solver run, or result exists anywhere in this repository; the tested range is fixture-scale synthetic feeders (lib-01…lib-08, three-bus and two-feeder fixtures) and the ×2/×4 in-memory portfolio copies; §19.3 forbids claiming feeder tests establish capability for a 10,000-bus network; enforced as P8.02 X-7 and restated in the P8.21 scaling protocol

named explicitly because §19.3 names it; the per-case IEEE exclusion record (carried in every scenarios/library/lib-*.json) records that no model is available in this repository and neither licensing nor model availability is confirmed; NO transmission case has been RUN here
same exclusion and same honest statement as NT-2 — no transmission case has been RUN in this repository

the §19.3 precondition ('where licensing and model availability are confirmed') is unconfirmed — the per-case IEEE exclusion record is the honest entry; a future inclusion requires the confirmed licensing AND a model source, recorded per case, and freezes a new benchmark-set version

items.case: unbalanced distribution networks (per-phase models, unbalanced power flow)
items.section_trace: report §19.1 distribution track; D3 (network class/model fidelity), OPEN
items.status: NOT RUN — out of the declared scope
items.reason: D3 is OPEN and the declared network class is balanced distribution (radial default RECOMMENDATION plus one balanced meshed fixture, lib-03); unbalanced topologies are out of scope unless an explicitly scoped design decision adds them (never assumed, never slipped in — the P8.10 §4 D3 obligation)

items.case: runtime topology-change event (feeder switching / line trip mid-horizon in the quasi-static grid model)
items.status: NOT RUN — no such case exists
items.reason: the repository covers topology-CLASS variation only (radial fixtures vs the balanced meshed two-feeder fixture, lib-03) — the lib-08 record states this honestly as 'a fixture-level topology class, not a runtime switching model'; no switching model, no mid-horizon topology event, and no case exercising one exists; a runtime topology-change case is a recorded candidate for benchmark-set v2

items.status: NOT RUN as a dedicated case — only analogues exist
items.reason: the recorded analogues are the lib-07 telemetry dropout window (no frames 12:00-13:00 UTC), the lib-04 worker-timeout fail-closed path, and the P5.21 fault-injection suite (dropped/reordered/duplicated messages) — and the P5.21 suite is WRITTEN-UNRUN; no sustained-loss benchmark case has been executed, and the worker_process backend itself is an UNVERIFIED pandapower API

items.section_trace: report §19.3 bullet 5 ('forecast error'); §19.4 flexibility metrics (uncertainty calibration)
items.status: NOT RUN — only a single deterministic error fixture exists
items.reason: the only forecast-error artefact in the repository is the deterministic v1-error-pv-ramp fixture (PV down 80 percent of clear-sky inside 12:00-13:00 UTC); no ensemble, no distributional forecast case, and therefore no uncertainty-calibration measurement case exists
no PyPSA integration, dependency, or case exists in this repository; the §19.1 track table names the tool, and naming a tool is not an integration

items.case: dynamic-stability cases (Kundur two-area, IEEE 14-bus with dynamic data) and any transient/frequency result
items.status: NOT RUN — out of this set's scope
items.reason: the dynamic track is the P8.16/P8.17 scope (ANDES, GPLv3-isolated), not this benchmark set; no dynamic simulation has been executed, and a steady-state power-flow tool must never be presented as transient-stability evidence (§19.1; P8.02 X-5)

items.status: NOT RUN — out of phase scope
items.reason: HIL requires a vendor/partner platform and is gated behind simulation, integration, and cyber reviews (§19.2(10)); nothing in this phase approaches that gate

scale_claim_rule: No capability, performance, or scale claim may be stated beyond the tested range declared in research-set-v1.json. The tested range is: synthetic fixture-scale distribution cases (three-bus radial; balanced two-feeder meshed) and the ×2/×4 in-memory portfolio-copy probe — raw numbers only, no scaling law derived from two or three points (benchmarks/README.md no-targets rule 3).
